au3-ftw-first-page_FtwFirstPage.au3-i18n-label_ftwFirstPageText:
This is the wizard that helps you when setting up
your vehicle. Please follow all of the steps to be able
to use all of the functions of this vehicle.

au3-ftw-account-overview_FtwAccountOverv.au3-i18n-label_ftwAccountOverviewText:
Add a user to save your individual vehicle, comfort
and Infotainment settings.
If you do not want to add a new user at this moment,
skip this step.

au3-ftw-account-choice_FtwAccountChoice.au3-i18n-label_ftwAccountOverviewText:
If you would like to use the full range of functions, add a myAudi user. You can
also create a local user without myAudi. Your individual settings can then only
be used in this vehicle. If this is the case, personalized online functions will not
be available.

au3-ftw-account-myaudi-new_FtwAccountMya.au3-i18n-label_ftwMyAudiNewTextEce:
Install the myAudi app on your smartphone and
register. It is available in the App Store or Google Play
Store. Follow the prompts in the app. If you already
have the myAudi app, please open it for the next
step. Add your vehicle in the app manually.
au3-ftw-account-myaudi-new_FtwAccountMya.au3-i18n-label_ftwMyAudiNewTextCN:
You can use myAudi China with your smart phone.
Please install the app and register on
www.my-audi.com.cn. For detailed information,
please contact your dealer.

au3-ftw-myaudi-add-car-wifi_FtwMyaudiAdd.au3-i18n-label_ftwMainMyAudiAddCarWifiTe:
To add your vehicle automatically to your user and
log in when in the vehicle, connect your smartphone
to the Wi-Fi access point.
au3-ftw-myaudi-add-car-wifi_FtwMyaudiAdd.au3-i18n-label_ftwMainMyAudiAddCarWifiOf:

however, it is required to set up your myAudi
services. Once activated, you can take advantage
of all myAudi services to their fullest extent.

This can be found behind the windshield and in your
vehicle documents.

au3-ftw-main-user-nomination-inst_FtwMai.au3-i18n-label_ftwMainUserNominationInst:
After you have finalized the key user contract, you
can set the key user in the vehicle. You will need the
10-digit vehicle code for this, which is located under
the opaque layer of security film on your vehicle key
fob. Use a firm object to rub the film off and see the
code.

After you finish the main users contract with the
dealer, you can now be nominated as the main user.
You can find the FPIN on your key chain.

Declaration of consent for speech dialog system online
recognizer

div_FtwEulaShortSubtextContainer.au3-i18n-label_FtwEulaShortText:
I accept the conditions and agree to the usage of my
data (see EULA).

au3-list_FtwEulaLongList.au3-i18n-label_FtwEulaLongText:
I agree that when using the "Text message dictation" service, my spoken data
(and personal data such as names and addresses contained therein) are
forwarded via AUDI AG to AUDI AG's service provider Cerence B.V., Netherlands
(Cerence) to be converted to text. This text is sent back to the vehicle via AUDI
AG.

I also agree that Cerence will forward, process and save my spoken data within
the EU and to the USA for the purpose of converting it to text and accept that
this spoken data and the corresponding texts thereof will be permanently
stored by Cerence to be used for ongoing optimization and further
development of the voice recognition technology. If this agreement is not
accepted, the "Text message dictation" service cannot be used. I will ensure
that other users of the service in this vehicle also accept these conditions. I can
withdraw my acceptance of this agreement with effect for the future at any
time by contacting AUDI AG.

au3-popup_AsiLegalNotice.au3-i18n-label#androidAutoNotes:
Your vehicle offers the option to use and operate various
functions of your smartphone via the vehicle's communication
system ("Audi MMI") using "Android Auto". The following
description provides you with information on how data is
collected by Android Auto. The Android Auto service is a service
offered by Google LLC, 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain
View, CA 94043 USA ("Google"). Android Auto allows you to
have apps that are running on your smartphone (such as
navigation services, sending and receiving messages or playing
music) displayed on the Audi MMI and also allows you to operate
them via the Audi MMI.

Additionally, specific data is sent from your vehicle to your
smartphone. Examples of this data include position data,
day/night mode and vehicle information like speed, odometer
and low fuel level information. This data is used for the purpose
of optimizing the Android Auto app experience on the Audi MMI
notably the use of navigation services.

Any further data processing for additional purposes other than
optimizing the Android Auto app experience on the Audi MMI is
determined solely by Google or third party suppliers. Therefore,
please refer closely to the corresponding privacy policies and
terms of use from Google and the third party app suppliers for
their respective apps.

au3-car-info-text_AQIDisclaimer.au3-i18n-label#TwoSensorInfotext:
The air quality display indicates how much particulate matter
(PM2.5) is in the air inside and outside the vehicle. To improve the
air quality inside your vehicle, close all of the windows and doors,
and activate the A/C cooling mode and the AUTO function. Also
make sure that auto recirculation is active. Note: when the outside
temperature is low, air from outside is gradually drawn in to
prevent the windows from fogging. This may change the air quality
in the vehicle.
au3-car-info-text_AQIDisclaimer.au3-i18n-label#SingleSensorInfotext:
The air quality display indicates how much particulate matter
(PM2.5) is in the air inside the vehicle. To improve the air quality
inside your vehicle, close all of the windows and doors, tap on the
leaf icon to activate the air quality function, and make sure the A/C
function is active. Note: when the outside temperature is low, air
from outside is gradually drawn in to prevent the windows from
fogging. This may change the air quality in the vehicle.

au3-privacy-info-default_default.au3-i18n-label_p1:
Activating the privacy mode will deactivate all online services
and data collection not required for safety, legal, or contractual
reasons. The following services cannot be deactivated in your
vehicle:
au3-privacy-info-default_default.au3-i18n-label_NoProtectedServices:
Activating privacy means that online services are no longer
available.
au3-privacy-info-default_default.au3-i18n-label#Ecall:
No online services are available because privacy mode is active.
In the event of an accident, a connection will be established to
make an emergency call.
au3-privacy-info-default_default.au3-i18n-label#EuEcall:
No online services are available because privacy mode is active.
In the event of an accident, a connection will be established to
make an emergency call.

au3-privacy-info-general_general.au3-i18n-label_p2:
An icon in the MMI status bar displays the privacy settings
currently selected.
au3-privacy-info-general_general.au3-i18n-label_p1:
When the online services are used or data collection is active,
data is transmitted from the vehicle to AUDI or the provider
responsible for the respective service. Here you can decide
whether to activate or deactivate the sending of certain data
types in order to protect your privacy. When certain data types
are deactivated, a portion of available online services and the
collection of data will be deactivated. Data collection means the
collection, processing, and saving of data that is not collected
through the online services. This type of data collection is used
to improve and develop products, including vehicle functions,
online services, and digital services. More information about this
can be found in the data privacy information in your MMI.
au3-privacy-info-general_general.au3-i18n-label_p3:
Please note that any changes to the privacy settings will only
affect the transfer of data through the SIM card integrated in
the vehicle. It does not apply to Bluetooth®, Wi-Fi and Audi
Smartphone Interface, among other things.
See owner’s manual

au3-privacy-info-gps_gps.au3-i18n-label_p1:
When your vehicle position is used, location-based online
services become available to you. To provide these services, your
vehicle position as well as personal data are transmitted to the
AUDI server or the provider responsible for the respective service
and are electronically processed there. The vehicle position is
not transmitted to any other third parties that do not require
vehicle position data in order to perform their services. Your
vehicle position is not accessible to other third parties such as
myAudi users authorized by you and the Customer Care center.
When this setting is activated, the online services listed below
are available to you. Some of the listed services may be
unavailable when this setting is deactivated. Refer to "Activate
privacy mode" in the info menu.
au3-privacy-info-gps_gps.au3-i18n-label_p3:
Grayed-out online services were deactivated in myAudi by the
key user and can be reactivated there at any time by the key
user.
au3-privacy-info-gps_gps.au3-i18n-label_p1NoServices:
Using your vehicle position makes location-based online services
available to you. To provide these services, your vehicle position
along with personal information will be transmitted to the AUDI
AG server and electronically processed there. However, the
vehicle position will not be accessible to third parties, for
example, Customer Service and other myAudi users you have
authorized.
au3-privacy-info-gps_gps.au3-i18n-label_NoServices:
No services that use the vehicle position are currently active in
your vehicle.

au3-privacy-info-tracking_tracking.au3-i18n-label_p1:
When you share your vehicle position, your location as well as
additional personal data are transmitted for the purposes of
providing the online services. This information is also made
visible to select individuals such as the key user, secondary users
and Customer Care centers. Deactivation will also affect
requests for data collection. When this setting is activated, the
online services listed below are available to you. Some of the
listed services may be unavailable when this setting is
deactivated. Refer to "Activate privacy mode" in the info menu.
au3-privacy-info-tracking_tracking.au3-i18n-label_p3:
Grayed-out online services were deactivated in myAudi by the
key user and can be reactivated there at any time by the key
user.
au3-privacy-info-tracking_tracking.au3-i18n-label_p1NoServices:
By sharing the vehicle position, your location as well as
additional personal data will be transmitted to provide the
online services and will be visible to select individuals, such as
Customer Service and myAudi users authorized by you.
au3-privacy-info-tracking_tracking.au3-i18n-label_NoServices:
There are currently no services active in your vehicle that are
sharing the vehicle position.

au3-privacy-info-personal_personal.au3-i18n-label_p1:
When personal data is used, your vehicle will exchange this data
with AUDI servers or the provider responsible for the respective
service. This may allow third parties, such as myAudi users
authorized by you and the Customer Care center, to access your
personal data. Data related to your location is not transmitted.
When this setting is activated, the online services listed below
are available to you. Some of the listed services may be
unavailable when this setting is deactivated. Refer to "Activate
privacy mode" in the info menu.
au3-privacy-info-personal_personal.au3-i18n-label_p3:
Grayed-out online services were deactivated in myAudi by the
key user and can be reactivated there at any time by the key
user.
au3-privacy-info-personal_personal.au3-i18n-label_p1NoServices:
When personal data is used, your vehicle will exchange this data
with AUDI AG servers. This may allow third parties, such as
Customer Service and myAudi users authorized by you, to access
your personal data. Data related to your location is not
transmitted.
au3-privacy-info-personal_personal.au3-i18n-label_NoServices:
No services that use personal data are currently active in your
vehicle.

au3-privacy-info-data-collection-persona.au3-i18n-label_p1:
Give consent to personal data collection requests in myAudi.
Once you have logged in to your myAudi account, you can
control the data collected for this vehicle. Location-based data
can be processed as long as the "Share vehicle position" function
is activated. You can find more information about data
collection requests at myAudi.

au3-privacy-info-data-collection-statist.au3-i18n-label_p1:
It is Audi's goal to either improve or redevelop existing products
for their customers; this includes vehicle functions, online
services, and digital services. To do this, your data is
pseudonymized so that the data can no longer be associated
with you without requiring additional information. Once you
have activated the "Share vehicle position" function,
location-based data can be processed. AUDI has implemented
measures to ensure that any reference to you as the driver or
owner of the vehicle can only be drawn in justified exceptional
cases, such as to perform recalls or if any safety or product
reliability issues are determined. No data is used that allows for
profiling or determines a behavior or patterns of behavior
specific to you.

au3-privacy-info-data-collection-anonym_.au3-i18n-label_AnonymData:
It is Audi's goal to either improve or redevelop existing products
for their customers; this includes vehicle functions, online
services, and digital services. To do this, your vehicle sends
anonymized data from the control modules to AUDI. This data is
collected and processed in such a way that your personal
information, your vehicle or the data sets linked to the vehicle
cannot be directly or indirectly inferred. No data is used that
allows for profiling or determines a behavior or patterns of
behavior specific to you.

au3-list_ScrollContainer.au3-i18n-label_PsoInfoText:
Add a user in order to save individual settings and access them again
later. Changes to settings in the vehicle are automatically saved to the
active user profile. The individual settings that are saved include various
Infotainment, comfort, and vehicle settings. The active user is assigned
to the vehicle key currently in use. If the vehicle is unlocked with a
vehicle key, the assigned user will be loaded. Log in as a myAudi user to
also use your individual settings in other vehicles and to have access to
your personalized online services. You can also create a local user, which
would only be available in this vehicle. Personalized online services are
not available here. The guest user can be used to apply changes to the
vehicle without changing the other user profiles.

au3-screen_Screen:UM_PU_INFO.au3-i18n-label_InfoText:
You must be an authorized user of this vehicle to
use the vehicle-related Audi connect services. A key
user must be selected first for the vehicle. The key
user can give other users authorization at
www.audi.com/myaudi. To become the key user of
the vehicle, you will need a verified myAudi user
account and the 10-digit vehicle code. The myAudi
username is the same as the email address you
used to register for myAudi. The vehicle code can
be found under an opaque layer of security film on
your vehicle key fob. Use a firm object to remove
the film and to make the vehicle code visible.
Please note that by removing the key user all
additional users and the corresponding
authorizations will be lost. The vehicle-related Audi
connect services can no longer be used. Removing
the key user will also lead to all assigned Audi
connect keys being deleted if your vehicle has this
service.

au3-screen_Screen:SETUP_GENERAL_DISCLAIM.au3-i18n-label_Eula:
When using the “Online Hybrid Speech Recognition” service
from AUDI AG, my spoken data (and any personal data therein)
including my current vehicle geo position data (referred to
collectively as “data”) is transmitted to AUDI AG and its service
provider Cerence B.V., Netherlands (Cerence) for speech
recognition. The speech recognition results will be sent back
to my vehicle and processed there (for controlling the
navigation system, for example). Transmitting the geo
position data at the same time helps to improve the accuracy
of the speech recognition system (for example, by limiting the
search to the closest result when there are multiple similar
locations). Geo position data is also needed in order for the
system to provide information related to the position of the
vehicle (such as searching for a nearby restaurant). The spoken
and geo position data will be processed by Cerence within the
EU and the USA. My data will be processed by AUDI AG and, as
anonymized data, by Cerence for the purpose of continuous
improvement and development of the speech recognition
system. I am aware that I can withdraw my consent at any
time effective immediately from that point forward by
contacting AUDI AG (Audi Kundenbetreuung Deutschland, PO
Box 10 04 57, 85045 Ingolstadt, kundenbetreuung@audi.de)
and by changing the speech recognition system settings. If I
do not give or withdraw my consent, the "Online Hybrid
Speech Recognition" service cannot be used. Additional
information about how data is processed as part of the
“Online Hybrid Speech Recognition” service as well as your
data privacy rights can be found in our privacy policy in your
vehicle’s MMI (Settings – General). I will ensure that others
who use the service in this vehicle also agree to the above
terms.

au3-car-info-text_AQIDisclaimer.au3-i18n-label#TwoSensorInfotext:
The air quality display indicates how much particulate matter
(PM2.5) is in the air inside and outside the vehicle. To improve
the air quality inside your vehicle, close all of the windows and
doors, and activate the A/C cooling mode and the AUTO
function. Also make sure that auto recirculation is active. Note:
when the outside temperature is low, air from outside is
gradually drawn in to prevent the windows from fogging. This
may change the air quality in the vehicle.
au3-car-info-text_AQIDisclaimer.au3-i18n-label#SingleSensorInfotext:
The air quality display indicates how much particulate matter
(PM2.5) is in the air inside the vehicle. To improve the air quality
inside your vehicle, close all of the windows and doors, tap on
the leaf icon to activate the air quality function, and make sure
the A/C function is active. Note: when the outside temperature
is low, air from outside is gradually drawn in to prevent the
windows from fogging. This may change the air quality in the
vehicle.

au3-screen_Screen:SETUP_GENERAL_LEGAL_AU.au3-i18n-label_SurroundingsOberservation:
Surrounding area monitoring system: The functionality of park
assist plus requires the vehicle's driving path to be detected
and evaluated. For this purpose, cameras installed on the
outside of the vehicle detect objects within the vehicle's range
of motion (for example, lane marker lines and guardrails). The
live images from the cameras are transmitted to the
responsible control module. The camera images are not
recorded or saved; they are rather transmitted directly to the
control module in the vehicle responsible for processing. This
control module analyzes the current camera image using
image analysis software. This image analysis software
calculates anonymous physical measurements and
approximate distances to stationary objects (for example,
guardrails) or to moving objects (for example, vehicles driving
ahead). The control module evaluates these physical
measurements and makes it possible for park assist plus to
control the vehicle. The anonymous physical measurements
are stored for several seconds on a volatile memory in the
control module. These cannot be linked to the identity of a
person or a vehicle (for example, faces or license plates).
au3-screen_Screen:SETUP_GENERAL_LEGAL_AU.au3-i18n-label_DataStorageForAutomaticDr:
Data memory: When park assist plus is active, the relevant
physical measurements from the surrounding area monitoring
system are stored together with other vehicle data (see the
data packet section for a detailed description about this data)
for several seconds on a volatile circular buffer in the vehicle.
The data stored in the circular buffer is continuously
overwritten after several seconds by the newest data. This
data is deleted when the ignition is switched off. The data will
be permanently stored only if one of the following triggers to
record data occurs:
- Airbag deployment
- Autonomous emergency braking
- Activation/deactivation of park assist plus
If a trigger to record data is detected (for example, if an airbag
deploys), the physical measurements, which were stored
several seconds prior to the event on the circular buffer that is
being constantly overwritten, are then transmitted to and
stored in a hard drive within the vehicle - referred to as the
data memory. To permanently store this data in the data
memory, there are six designated memory locations. One data
packet can be stored per one memory location.

au3-screen_Screen:SETUP_GENERAL_LEGAL_AU.au3-i18n-label_DataStorageForAutomaticDr:
The respective data packet contains data pertaining to the
following categories:
- Driver interaction (for example, the driver presses the brake
pedal or turns the steering wheel)
- Status of the park assist function (for example, "park assist
plus was activated")
- Vehicle dynamics (for example, linear and lateral
acceleration)
- Surrounding area (for example, sensor range)
Depending on the triggering event, the data packets are
stored at different memory locations in the data memory:
a.) Data packets for accidents that are detected when park
assist plus is active:
If an accident is detected (meaning an airbag deployed), the
data packet from the last several seconds before the accident
will be permanently stored in the data memory. These data
packets cannot be overwritten. The data memory has up to six
memory locations for such events.
b.) Data packets for other defined events when park assist
plus is active:
If another defined event occurs when park assist plus is active
(such as autonomous emergency braking), the data packet is
stored in one of the six memory locations for the data
memory and can be overwritten. The data packets for such
events can be overwritten if the six designated memory
locations are full and another accident or another defined
event triggers a new data recording. If this is the case, the
oldest data packet capable of being overwritten is always
overwritten. The data packets stored for detected accidents
(scenario a. above) cannot be overwritten. The data described
above is processed locally in the vehicle. This data is not
transmitted automatically (for example, through an air
interface) to AUDI AG or other third parties. Therefore, the
data is only stored in the vehicle. AUDI AG does not have
access to this data in the vehicle.

au3-screen_Screen:NPR_Information--CLU33.au3-i18n-label_NppInformationText:
Please be noted that your plate number will be sent to
Navigation online server while using the feature in order to
provide better service.

The service includes below sub-features:

Notification and reminder: there will be notifications when your
car is limited to drive into certain road or area at the restricted
time.

Map presentation: during the period of Number Plate
Restriction, the map will always show all the restricted area to
current plate number.

Routing and guidance: the route calculating will automatic
avoid the restricted road and area. When the restricted area
cannot be avoided, there will be warning together with voice
announcement to provide reminder.

In order to get the above features properly, please input your
plate number correctly.
